varieties.name: Green Valiant
varieties.traits: Possibly the most popular broccoli cultivar in KZN
varieties.note: Zones are this pass's inference: the source's sowing-time table gives broccoli windows for 'cold areas (heavy frost)' Sept-Jan, 'warm areas (light frost)' Jan-Sept, and 'hot areas (frost free)' Feb-June/July, without tying named cultivars to a specific one of those three groups — so all cultivars from this source are given the same broad zone spread rather than an unsupported narrower pick.
